name: Antique Golden Style - CE
description: The Antique Golden Style LoRA was trained on images with rich golden hues to produce a particular style, characterized by colorful sunsets and an antique quality. V02 Version 1 lacked some flexibility, particularly when it came to indoor scenes. I produced a new set of training images to create version 2. Overall, it seems to retain the same characteristics. but with improved results. Please share your creations. I would love to see how you have used the LoRA.
